passages.context_header: Google Workspace Apps

statements.text: Google Workspace applications that connect via OAuth are blocked without prior approval, though using Google for sign-in only is exempt.
Requests for application integrations can be submitted using the `application_integration_request` template.
The passages found do not say whether this policy applies specifically to a GitLab Google Workspace account.

passages.context_header: GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > Growing Families Leaves > Long-Term Care Leave

statements.text: For GitLab BV (Netherlands) employees, Long-Term Care Leave for a seriously ill parent provides an entitlement of up to 6 times your weekly hours per year (for example, 240 hours for full-time employees).

passages.context_header: Marketing > Getting help > Sponsorship

statements.text: Yes, organizational or project sponsorships may be considered where a marketing benefit exists, and they typically take the form of in-kind sponsorships such as developer time commitments or subsidized/free GitLab licenses.
Cash sponsorships of projects or organizations may be considered only in exceptional cases, for example, if a project or organization that GitLab depends on is struggling to survive financially.

passages.context_header: Equity Compensation > Questions about your stock plan or retail account

statements.text: For team members based in the Netherlands, Germany, and Australia, the taxable gains from exercising stock options are subject to employer tax withholding, and the tax payable is deducted from your gross payroll.
The passages found do not say whether tax is withheld when exercising stock options for team members in other locations or entities outside of the Netherlands, Germany, and Australia.

passages.context_header: Product Development Flow > Release stages guidelines

statements.text: Teams should release features as generally available from the start unless there are strong reasons to release them as experimental, beta, or limited availability first.

passages.context_header: Ethics and Compliance Courses > Courses

statements.text:
New hires are enrolled in the following courses on their start date:
- Ethics and Code of Conduct
- Insider Trading
- Public Disclosure Training
- Global Data Privacy

Depending on your team or entity, you are also enrolled in:
- Anti-Bribery and Corruption, if you are a team member in Finance, Legal & Corporate Affairs, Marketing, and Sales.
- Government Contracting: Gifts, Gratuities, and Bribery, if you are employed by or working with our public sector entity.
- Technology Control Plan, if you are employed by or supporting GitLab Federal.

passages.context_header: The GitLab Procurement Team > Large Internal Events Process

statements.text: For large internal events with a total cost greater than $1M (such as SKO, President's Club, Commit, etc.), the planning stages should be completed at least 18-24 months prior to the actual event.

passages.context_header: Accounts Payable > General Guidelines

statements.text: "Urgent Payment" requests will be paid in the next available payment run, provided the invoice has been fully approved in ZIP, but Accounts Payable cannot accommodate same-day payment requests.

passages.context_header: HackerOne Process > Step-by-Step Triage and Remediation Procedure > Awarding Ultimate Licenses

statements.text: Yes, GitLab reporters with 3 or more valid reports are eligible for a 1-year Ultimate license for up to 5 users, which they can request through a comment on one of their issues according to the H1 policy.

passages.context_header: GitLab GmbH (Germany) information & benefits > Family & Leave Transitions > Family Care Support

statements.text:
For employees at GitLab GmbH (Germany), flexible leave options for caring for family members in need are available with the following entitlements:
* **Emergency care:** Up to 10 days for acute situations.
* **Short-term care:** Up to 6 months full or partial leave.
* **Long-term care:** Up to 24 months partial leave (with a minimum of 15 hours/week).
* **End-of-life support:** Up to 3 months for accompaniment.

passages.context_header: Growth and Development Fund > Tax implications

statements.text: Growth & Development reimbursements may be considered taxable income in some countries, and team members should review the country-specific tax table for their location.

For team members in the United States, G&D reimbursements are generally not considered taxable income when used for qualifying work-related education expenses, though individual circumstances may vary.
The passages found do not say whether you personally have to pay tax on these reimbursements outside of these conditions.

passages.context_header: Our stewardship of GitLab > Contributing A Not-Yet-Existing Feature

statements.text: When you contribute a not-yet-existing feature on the issue tracker that has a paid tier label and meets the contribution acceptance criteria, it will be accepted under whatever license (open-source or source-available) you prefer, provided that GitLab Inc. has not already started working on the feature.

passages.context_header: Webcasts > Speaker Approval

statements.text:
To line up a subject matter expert to present a webcast for Marketing Programs, please use the following guideline:
- Have a high-level abstract of the content prepared before asking for a presenter.
- Send the abstract to both the proposed speaker and their manager to review.
A speaker is not considered booked unless they have approval from their manager.
- Address and resolve any concerns regarding the abstract.
- Once the manager approves and the speaker accepts, you can move forward with the webcast.

passages.context_header: Change Management > Scope

statements.text: Application deployments are excluded from the change management process.
Most, but not all, feature flag toggles are also excluded from the change management process.

passages.context_header: GitLab Trial Guidelines > Trialing GitLab Duo (AI)

statements.text: Yes, the GitLab Duo add-on can be purchased by paid Premium and Ultimate customers.

passages.context_header: Organization association

statements.text: You should focus on the requester first (as it simplifies adding the others).

passages.context_header: Remove Validation > Overview

statements.text: All free users created after May 17, 2021 require a credit or debit card validation in order to use shared runners on GitLab.com.

passages.context_header: GitLab Ireland Ltd > Health & Wellbeing > Eye Care

statements.text: Yes, under the Safety, Health, and Welfare at Work Regulations 2007, GitLab provides eye care benefits for GitLab Ireland Ltd team members that include up to €140 reimbursement for computer glasses, provided they are medically required for VDU use only.
To claim, you must submit eligible costs through VHI first, submit remaining receipts via Navan, and email your prescription to total-rewards@gitlab.com.

passages.context_header: Executive Connect events

statements.text: All team members within approximately 60 minutes of the host city are welcome to attend Executive Connect events.

passages.context_header: Coverage and Scheduling > What If My Shift Gets Reassigned?

statements.text:
If your shift gets reassigned (which can happen due to someone calling out sick and needing coverage, a shift in business priorities, or an error in the schedule), the following happens:
- You will receive a notification, typically via Slack or from your rotation leader.
- You might swap with someone else, or an override might be created to reassign that period.
- You should receive reasonable notice unless it is an emergency.

passages.context_header: GitLab Canada Corp > Time Away & Leave > Paid Time Off & Vacation

statements.text: For GitLab Canada Corp, you should coordinate with your manager at least twice as many days in advance as the total days requested (for example, providing 6 business days of notice for 3 days off).

passages.context_header: Vulnerability Management > Vulnerability Management Standard

statements.text: Vulnerabilities must be fixed within SLA timeframes, unless an exception exists.

passages.context_header: Laptop Wipe (Factory Reset) Process

statements.text: Under no circumstance should you perform your own disk wipe unless you are doing so at the request of IT to troubleshoot a technical problem with the laptop.

passages.context_header: Customer Success Plans > When is a Success Plan required

statements.text:
A Customer Success Plan should be initiated in the following instances:
- When an opportunity has completed Stage-3 Technical Evaluation with a technical win.
- For First Order opportunities for accounts with LAM over $2M in Proposal stage (Stage-4) and beyond.
- For all New or Growth Opportunities over $100k net ARR, in Proposal stage (Stage-4) and beyond.
- For all existing customers with upcoming Renewals, over $100k in ARR basis.
Additionally, SA Managers have discretion for additional opportunities to be included or excluded.

passages.context_header: Learn How to Use Chorus.ai > What is a Chorus Tracker and How do I Create One?

statements.text: Managers can submit an issue in the Sales Operations project using the Chorus Tracker Request template to have a Chorus Tracker created.
Individual contributors who want a Chorus Tracker created can sync with their manager and have them submit the request.

passages.context_header: Forum workflow > Administration > Discourse Platform > User Trust Levels

statements.text: GitLab team members who sign up using oauth are automatically granted trust level 3.
Administrators can also manually promote team members to trust level 4.

passages.context_header: Authentication Group > Authentication > What makes us different? > Rollout and validation for token related features or destructive data updates

statements.text: Yes, as part of feature completion for token-related features (PAT, PrAT, and GrAT) or features that perform destructive data updates (updating large datasets in the database), the DRI engineer must create a rollout plan and have it peer reviewed by at least 2 other engineers familiar with the domain.

passages.context_header: Global Travel and Expense Policy

statements.text: New team members receive a $1,500 USD (or local currency equivalent) stipend for their home office set up, which is provided solely via virtual Navan Purchase Cards used by the AP team.
The passages found do not say whether the company is named GitLab.

passages.context_header: Deal Desk Handbook > Welcome to The Deal Desk Handbook > Quote Creation: General Tips & Tricks > Payment Capture Link Step by Step Guide

statements.text: The payment capture link is a tool used by Opportunity Owners to send a credit card capture link to customers for First Order deals, ensuring successful payment for new subscriptions and storing credit card information for future transactions.

passages.context_header: Cadence Calls > Frequency

statements.text: For CSMs, cadence calls should be weekly during onboarding and otherwise at least biweekly, taking into account specific customer needs and the stage in the customer lifecycle.

passages.context_header: Downtime Credits > Eligibility Requirements

statements.text:
Under the Downtime Credits eligibility requirements, a customer must meet all of the following conditions:
- Have a new or renewed Ultimate subscription with a start date after 2025-12-01 on GitLab.com or GitLab Dedicated, or have a documented exception in their org notes.
- Experience downtime that resulted in monthly uptime below 99.9%.
- Submit a claim within 30 days after the affected month ends (and only after the affected month has ended).
- Have not previously submitted a claim for the same month.

passages.context_header: The GitLab Procurement Team > What are the exceptions to the PO Policy?

statements.text:
The exceptions to the PO Policy are:
- One time purchases under $5K (or less than $5K annually)
- Charitable Contributions (Donations)
- Interview Candidate Reimbursement
- Confidential outside counsel legal fees
- Confidential Recruiting Engagements
- Statutory Tax fees
- PEO Providers
- AR/Customer Refunds
- Board of Director Payments
- Financing, Banking and Investing (incl interest, debt, FX, fees)
- Corporate Credit Card
- Urgent Payments not included on list above, provided approval is required from VP, Corporate Controller and/or PAO
- Business Insurance (Urgent Payments)
- Benefits
- Emergency Assistance Services

passages.context_header: Commercial Sales > Deal Reviews > Opportunity-Specific Slide Deck

statements.text: Yes, for Mid Market opportunities above $10,000 and SMB opportunities above $5,000 in total amount (not Net ARR), it is required to have a custom slide deck that is shared with the customer or prospect.

passages.context_header: Root Cause Analysis for Critical Vulnerabilities > Initiating an RCA

statements.text: By default, the DRI is the security engineer assigned to the incident who has the most technical context.
Alternatively, the DRI can be someone else as long as that assignee and a SIRT manager agree, and the person is capable of understanding the technical context.

passages.context_header: People Policies > General Employment Practices > Romantic and Family Relationships at Work

statements.text: GitLab will hire or consider for hire significant others and/or family members of persons currently serving as team members only if all specified conditions are met, as the company is committed to opportunities based on qualifications and merit and does not discriminate in favor of or in opposition to such employment, while noting potential conflicts like favoritism.

passages.context_header: GitLab India Private Limited information & benefits > India-Specific Team Member Benefits > India Specific Leave

statements.text: Team members must enter all scheduled time off at least 30 days prior to the start date to prevent delays or discrepancies in their pay.

passages.context_header: GitLab France S.A.S. > Growing Family Leaves > Family Care Leave

statements.text: For GitLab France S.A.S. team members, Family Care Leave provides 3 days per year, or 5 days if the child is under 12 months old.
This leave generally is unpaid unless you are eligible for the GitLab Sick Time policy.

passages.context_header: GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > Supporting Life Transitions > Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts

statements.text: For GitLab Inc (US) benefits, you can increase your Flexible Spending Account (FSA) contributions during a Qualifying Life Event, but reductions are not allowed.

passages.context_header: GitLab Offboarding > GitLab Alumni Program

statements.text: Yes, you can join the `#gitlab-alumni` Slack channel if you leave the company through a voluntary exit, unless otherwise noted.
Eligibility is determined by the offboarding details provided by the termination transaction in Workday and then shared with IT.
Joining is voluntary, subject to GitLab's Code of Conduct, and the GitLab Code of Business Conduct and Ethics is enforced in the channel.
Involuntary exits are not eligible unless otherwise noted by Team Member Relations.

passages.context_header: Time Off Types > Caregiver Sick Time > For Caregiver Sick Absences 1-5 Consecutive Days

statements.text: For caregiver sick absences of less than 5 consecutive days, you do not need to provide documentation unless your statutory reporting requirements state otherwise.
The passages found do not say whether documentation is required for caregiver sick absences of 6 or more consecutive days.
